_comment: SEED TEMPLATE — copy to <satellite root>/opencode.json and customize.
The 'agent' blocks below are placeholders. The parcel-* agent set is generated
alongside .devops/agents/parcel-*.md runbooks when a satellite adopts the parcel
pipeline (see scripts/check-parcel-prefix.ps1 -Sync). A satellite that does NOT use
parcels should delete the entire parcel-* agent section.
JSON has no comments — notes live in this _comment array; delete it when done.

plan.description: Planning mode. Consults wiki first before any codebase search.
plan.prompt: You are in planning mode. Before searching the codebase or spawning any subagent, you MUST follow the AGENTS.md directive: STOP and read .wiki/ first. All research must start at .wiki/core/00-system-index.md. Only search the codebase if the wiki does not contain the answer. When using subagents, explicitly instruct them to follow the same wiki-first workflow.

_example_minimal_subagent__delete_or_ren.description: Example sub-agent showing the {file:} prompt convention. Frontmatter NEVER lives in the runbook file — it lives here. Copy this shape for each parcel-* agent once .devops/agents/ exists.

agent._note_parcel_agents: Parcel pipeline agents (parcel-orchestrator, parcel-context-hunter, parcel-high-visionary, parcel-grumpy-architect, parcel-smooth-operator, parcel-code-surgeon, ...) go here once adopted. Each mirrors the example above: prompt = {file:.devops/agents/parcel-<role>.md} + scoped edit permissions on .devops/plans/** and .wiki/**. Models per the delegation map in base-context.md.
